lines.japanese:
―――朝になった。
　目が覚めて、枕元のメガネをかける。
　窓越しに見える空は、雲一つない青空だった。
「………………」
　非の打ち所のない朝を迎えたっていうのに、気分は暗く沈んでいる。
　理由は考えるまでもない。
　昨夜のアルクェイドとの一件が脳裏から離れてくれず、そのたびに罪悪感にさいなまれてしまうせいだ。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Morning.
I wake, put on the glasses beside my pillow,
and look through the window at a blue sky without a cloud in it.
“……”
The morning is flawless, yet my spirits are leaden.
I don’t need to ask why.
What happened with Arcueid last night will not leave my mind, and guilt gnaws at me whenever I remember it.

lines.mirrorMoon:
----It's morning.
I open my eyes and put on the glasses near my bed.
Looking out the window, I see a cloudless blue sky.
"………………"
Even though a flawless morning greets me, I can't help but feel down.
There's no need to wonder why.
What happened with Arcueid last night sticks in the back of my mind, and the accompanying guilt troubles me.

lines.japanese:
「……お互い忘れましょうって―――忘れられるわけないだろ、あれが」
　じっと両手を見つめる。
　この指はまだアルクェイドの体を覚えている。
　今もあいつの肌の手触りとか、冷たく滑るような体温を思い出せる。
　あの時は何も考えられなかったけれど、こうして振り返ってみればはっきりとわかる。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
“‘Let’s both forget it’…
How am I supposed to forget that?”
I stare at my hands.
These fingers still remember Arcueid’s body: the texture of her skin, the cool, silken glide of her warmth.
I could think of nothing then, but looking back, I understand perfectly.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… She said we should just forget it----but I can't forget such a thing."
I look at both my hands.
Those fingers still remember how Arcueid felt.
Even now I remember the texture of her skin and her cool, gliding body temperature.
I wasn't thinking at all back then, but I understand it all now.

lines.japanese:
あんなコトをしておいて。
　アルクェイドは忘れましょうと、無かったコトにしてくれたっていうのに、俺はそれを悔いると同時に、これっぽっちも忘れられないでいる。
　悔いることがあるとすれば、あの時どうして自分はまともな理性を持てなかったのか、という事だけだ。
　あんな動物みたいに触れるんじゃなくて、もっと人間として触れていれば、それはどんなに―――
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
After what I did, Arcueid still offered to treat it as though it had never happened, simply telling me to forget.
Yet even as I regret it, I cannot forget a single part.
My only real regret is that I had no sane human reason left in me at the time.
If I had touched her as a human being instead of an animal, how much more—

But while I regret it totally, I can't even forget one little bit of it.
What I regret is not being able to control myself back then.
If I didn't touch her like some animal, if I touched her more like a human, how would things have----

lines.japanese:
―――わかってた。
　俺はアルクェイドの金色の目を見て我を失ったんじゃない。
　ただ自分自身で気がつかなかっただけで、もうずっと以前から、遠野志貴はあいつ自身にいかれていたんだ。
　そんな単純なことを、俺は今になって気がつくなんて――――
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
―――I had known.
I didn’t lose myself because I looked into Arcueid’s golden eyes.
I simply hadn’t realized that Shiki Tohno had been crazy about her—about Arcueid herself—for a long, long time.
And I’m only discovering something so simple now—

lines.japanese:
屋敷の朝の光景はいつもと変わらない。
　翡翠が起こしにきてくれて、居間に行くと秋葉と琥珀さんがいて、学校に行く前に軽い挨拶をかわす。
　いつもと何も変わらない。
　なのに気分はどうしようもなく空っぽで、誰に話しかけられてもまともに返事をする事もできず、上の空で屋敷を後にした。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
Morning at the mansion is unchanged.
Hisui wakes me; Akiha and Kohaku are waiting in the sitting room; we exchange a few words before school.
Nothing is different.
Yet I feel hopelessly hollow. I can’t answer properly when anyone speaks to me, and I leave the mansion in a daze.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Hisui comes to wake me.
Akiha and Kohaku-san are in the sitting room, and we greet each other briefly before we go to school.
The same as always.
Yet I feel so empty, I can't even respond properly when people talk to me, and I leave the mansion vacantly.

lines.japanese:
正門をくぐる生徒たちはみな陽気そうだった。
「そっか。
今日は土曜日だったっけ」
　ここ数日間、アルクェイドに振りまわされていたせいでまるっきり曜日の感覚がなくなっている。
　曜日といえば、初めてあいつと出会ったのは金曜日だったけど。
　あいつは一週間前の朝、学校の前の交差点で俺を待っていたんだっけ。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
The students streaming through the front gate all seem cheerful.
“Oh. Right. It’s Saturday.”
After several days of being dragged around by Arcueid, I’ve completely lost track of what day it is.
Speaking of days, I first met her on a Friday.
One week ago this morning, she was waiting for me at the intersection outside school.

lines.japanese:
「……あいつ、笑ってたよな、たしか」
　そういえば、たしかに笑っていた。
　自分を殺した相手を待ち伏せしていたっていうのに、楽しそうに目を輝かせて遠野志貴っていう殺人者を待っていた。
「……なんでだろうな。
もし今夜あいつが来るなら、理由ぐらいは聞いてみようか」
　呟いて、よけい気が重くなった。
　たぶんアルクェイドは公園にはやってこない。
　思い返せば思い返すほど、昨日の夜は最後の夜だったんだと実感する。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
“…She was smiling, wasn’t she?”
Yes. She definitely was.
Though she was lying in wait for the man who had killed her, her eyes shone with delight as she waited for the murderer called Shiki Tohno.
“…Why, I wonder. If she comes tonight, maybe I’ll ask.”
Muttering it only weighs me down further.
Arcueid probably won’t come to the park.
The more I remember last night, the more certain I become that it was our last.

lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
That is why I feel so heavy, why nothing can hold my attention.
I may never see Arcueid again. The regret winds around my body like a length of iron chain—

「…………」

　いつもなら相手をしてもいいんだけど、今日にかぎっては有彦の相手をするほど元気がない。
lines.label: s183
lines.maoEnglish:
I sit at my desk.
Homeroom is barely five minutes away.
With nothing else to do, I stare blankly across the schoolyard.
“……”
A leaden sigh escapes me.
Ordinarily I might humor him, but today I don’t have the strength for Arihiko.

昨日は学校にはこない、来たら来たでヌケガラとはね。

「―――有彦。
悪いけど今日は一人にしてくれ。
いいだろ、俺なんかがいなくてもおまえには先輩がいるんだから。
いや、むしろ俺がいないほうがラッキーなんじゃないか？」

lines.maoEnglish:
“What's with you? You skipped school yesterday, then show up today as an empty shell. Honestly, Tohno, if you're going to mope like that, there's no fun in coming to school at all.”
Arihiko gives an extravagant shrug.
“Arihiko, sorry, but leave me alone today. You’ll be fine without me—you’ve got that upperclassman of yours. If anything, you’re lucky I’m not around, right?”
“Huh? What upperclassman? I don’t know anybody in third year.”

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Shiki has just repeated Ciel’s name. Arihiko answers with らるく先輩: Laruku is the standard Japanese shorthand for the rock band L’Arc-en-Ciel, so he turns Ciel into a band-name joke while insisting he does not know her. mirror moon deletes らるく altogether and leaves only ‘this senpai,’ erasing both the allusion and the audible proof that Arihiko heard the strange name rather than simply failing to catch it.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Arihiko's L’Arc-en-Ciel joke disappears

正直に言うと、もう会えないかなって思ってたから」
「―――え？
　志貴ったら、たった二時間待たされただけなのにそんなコト思ってたの？」
「……違う。
昨日、あんなコトがあったから。
俺は、もう会えないってずっと思ってたんだ」
「――――」
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Anyway, I’m glad to see you. Honestly, I thought I might never see you again.”
“What? You thought that just because I kept you waiting two hours?”
“No. Because of what happened yesterday. I spent all day thinking I’d never see you again.”
“……”
lines.mao_english:

“No. Because of what happened yesterday. I spent all day thinking I’d never see you again.”
“……”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"I'm glad you came.
To be honest, I thought I'd never see you again."
"---Eh?
You thought so after only waiting two hours?"
"…… That's not it.
It's because of last night.
I thought we would never meet again."
"----"
lines.mirror_moon:

"…… That's not it.

"----"

lines.japanese:
「……だめだよ、志貴。
あのコトは忘れましょうって、言ったのに」
　アルクェイドの声は弱々しい。
「あ―――――」
　……バカ。
　もう、これ以上ないっていうぐらい、俺は馬鹿だ。
　アルクェイドがいつも通りだなんて、勝手に、自分の都合のいいように思っていた。
　けど、それは違う。
　アルクェイドはアルクェイドなりに、俺の事を気遣っていつもと変わらないように接してくれていたのに。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“…You shouldn’t say that, Shiki. I told you we should forget it.”
Arcueid’s voice is faint.
“Ah…”
…Idiot.
I am a greater fool than words can express.
I decided, for my own convenience, that Arcueid was acting normally because nothing troubled her.
But I was wrong.
This was merely her way of sparing me—pretending everything was unchanged.
lines.mao_english:
“…You shouldn’t say that, Shiki. I told you we should forget it.”
Arcueid’s voice is faint.
“Ah…”
…Idiot.
I am a greater fool than words can express.
I decided, for my own convenience, that Arcueid was acting normally because nothing troubled her.
But I was wrong.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… That won't do, Shiki.
I said to just forget about it."
Arcueid says this weakly.
"Ah-----"
…… Idiot.
I am such an idiot.
I selfishly thought she was acting completely normal.
But, I was wrong.
She was acting that way so I wouldn't feel bad.
lines.mirror_moon:
"…… That won't do, Shiki.

"Ah-----"
…… Idiot.
I am such an idiot.

lines.japanese:
「……悪い。
俺が馬鹿だった。
これじゃおまえのことを怒鳴る資格なんかないよな」
「もういいって言ってるのに。
責任があるとしたらそれはわたしのほうなのよ。
だから忘れて。
そのほうがお互いに都合がいいでしょ？」
　アルクェイドは明るい口調でごまかそうとする。
　昨夜の事とか、それを気にしている自分とかを。
　けれど。
　そんな顔をして忘れろ、と言われても、よけいに忘れられるはずがない。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Sorry. I'm an idiot. That means I have no right to yell at you.”
“I told you, it’s all right. If anyone was responsible, it was me.
So forget it.
That would be easier for both of us, wouldn’t it?”
Arcueid tries to hide behind a bright voice—hide last night and the fact that it still troubles her.
But when she looks like that and tells me to forget, it only makes it harder to forget.
lines.mao_english:

So forget it.

Arcueid tries to hide behind a bright voice—hide last night and the fact that it still troubles her.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Sorry.
I was an idiot.
I don't have any right to yell at you anymore."
"I said it's okay.
If anyone is to blame, it's me.
So just forget about it.
Isn't that better for the both of us?"
She tries to fool us both by speaking cheerfully.
Fool us about last night, fool us about how bothered she is.
But.
Telling me to forget with that expression, how can I forget?

lines.japanese:
「―――違う。
俺が悪いって言ってるのは、昨夜のことじゃない。
俺が俺自身を馬鹿だっていっているのは、忘れるべきことをどうしても忘れられないからだ」
「え―――志貴？」
「今日だって朝からずっとおまえのことを考えてた。
おまえに会えたらなんて謝って、なんて言ったらいいだろうって、ずっと考えてたんだ。
　それを、いまさら―――忘れることなんて、できるわけないだろ」
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“No. I’m not calling myself an idiot because of last night. I’m an idiot because I cannot forget what I’m supposed to.”
“Shiki…?”
“I thought about you all day. I kept wondering how I could apologize, what I could possibly say if I saw you.
How can I suddenly forget all of that now?”
lines.mao_english:
“No. I’m not calling myself an idiot because of last night. I’m an idiot because I cannot forget what I’m supposed to.”
“Shiki…?”
“I thought about you all day. I kept wondering how I could apologize, what I could possibly say if I saw you.
How can I suddenly forget all of that now?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---No.
I wasn't apologizing for last night.
I'm an idiot because I can't forget about something I should forget."
"Eh---Shiki?"
"Since this morning, all I thought about was you.
All I could think about was how I should apologize to you and what to say after I saw you.
So, I can't---just forget about it now."
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「――――」
　アルクェイドは俺から視線を逸らす。
　俺も―――彼女を正面から見ることはできなかった。
言ってはいけない事を言ってしまった気がして、彼女と目が合わせられない。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“……”
Arcueid looks away.
I cannot face her either. It feels as though I have said something forbidden, and I can no longer meet her eyes.
lines.mao_english:
“……”
Arcueid looks away.
I cannot face her either. It feels as though I have said something forbidden, and I can no longer meet her eyes.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----"
Arcueid looks away.
I---can't look at her either.
After sensing I said something I shouldn't have, I can't look into her eyes now.
lines.mirror_moon:
"----"
Arcueid looks away.
I---can't look at her either.
After sensing I said something I shouldn't have, I can't look into her eyes now.

lines.japanese:
アルクェイドからの返答はない。
　お互い、相手の次の台詞を待って、結果として、長い沈黙が訪れた。
―――どのくらいの時間、そうして二人きりで立ち尽くしていたのかわからない。
　ただ、アルクェイドはかすかに頷いた。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
Arcueid gives no answer.
Each of us waits for the other to speak, until an immense silence settles between us.
―――I don’t know how long we stand there alone together.
At last, Arcueid gives the smallest nod.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
She doesn't respond.
I can't either, and a long silence begins.
---I don't know how long the two of us stood there.
Arcueid nods slightly.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……うん、ほんとうのことを言えばね。
「わたしだって忘れられなかったよ、志貴」
　頬を赤らめて、言いにくそうにアルクェイドはそう言った。
「アルクェイド――――」
　その姿がどうしようもなく、可愛い。
　そう思えた瞬間―――アルクェイドはザッとまわりを見渡した。
　いつのまにか周囲には何人もの人影が集まっていて、こちらを取り囲むように、じっと息を殺している。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Yes. If I'm honest—
“I couldn’t forget either, Shiki.”
Blushing, Arcueid admits it with difficulty.
“Arcueid――――”
She is unbearably adorable.
The moment I think it, Arcueid whips her gaze around us.
Several figures have gathered without my noticing. They surround us in perfect silence, scarcely breathing.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yeah, to tell the truth.
I couldn't forget about it either, Shiki."
Arcueid blushes as she says this with some difficulty.
"Arcueid----"
She looks so cute doing that.
As soon as I think that---Arcueid looks around her.
I don't know when this happened, but we're surrounded by human shapes.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「な………！」
　突然のことで思考が働かない。
「囲まれてるわ。
志貴、準備をして。
戦わなければ殺されるだけよ」
「戦うって、それじゃあこいつら―――」
「志貴もメガネを外せば解るでしょう。
彼らは、指の一本にだって正常な血が流れていない“死者”の群れよ」
「…………！」
　急いでナイフを取り出して、メガネを外す。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
The shock empties my mind.
“We’re surrounded. Get ready, Shiki. If we don’t fight, they’ll kill us.”
“Fight? Then these people are—”
“Take off your glasses and you’ll understand. Not one of them has normal blood flowing even to their fingertips. They are a pack of the Dead.”
“…!”
I pull out my knife and tear off my glasses.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Wha………!?"
I can't think since it was so sudden.
"We're surrounded.
Get ready Shiki.
If you don't fight, you'll just die."
"Fight?
Then they---"
"If you take off your glasses, you'll get it, won't you?
They are 'The Dead' without even a finger's worth of normal blood."
"…………!"
I quickly take out my knife and take off my glasses.

lines.japanese:
たしかに。
　俺とアルクェイドを取り囲む五人ほどの人間は、人のカタチをしたラクガキの線だった。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
She is right.
The five people surrounding us are only scribbled lines arranged in human shapes.
lines.mao_english:
She is right.
The five people surrounding us are only scribbled lines arranged in human shapes.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Like she says,
The five people surrounding us are just scribbled lines making a human shape.
lines.mirror_moon:
Like she says,

lines.japanese:
「なんで―――！
　死者はもう打ち止めだって昨日言ったじゃないか、アルクェイド！」
「―――ええ。
このヒトガタたちは昨日の夜、わたしが滅ぼした死者たちよ」
　アルクェイドは目を細めてまわりの死者たちを睨む。
　じり、と緩慢な動作で死者たちは近寄ってくる。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“How!? You said last night there wouldn’t be any more of the Dead, Arcueid!”
“Yes. These human-shaped things are the Dead I destroyed last night.”
Arcueid narrows her eyes at them.
Inch by sluggish inch, they close in.
lines.mao_english:
“How!? You said last night there wouldn’t be any more of the Dead, Arcueid!”
“Yes. These human-shaped things are the Dead I destroyed last night.”
Arcueid narrows her eyes at them.
Inch by sluggish inch, they close in.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Why---!?
You said you killed them all yesterday, Arcueid!"
"---Yes.
These are the ones I destroyed yesterday."
She narrows her eyes and glares at them.
They advance sluggishly.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Why---!?
You said you killed them all yesterday, Arcueid!"
"---Yes.
These are the ones I destroyed yesterday."
She narrows her eyes and glares at them.
They advance sluggishly.

lines.japanese:
「昨日って、それじゃあ死んだふりをしてたっていうのか……！？」
「まさか。
わたし、そんな事を見逃すほど弱ってないわ。
……けど、気が抜けてるのは弁解のしようがないかな。
こいつらが灰になって消え去るのを見届けなかったんだから」
　じり。
　さらに包囲網を縮めてくる死者たち。
　ナイフを構える自分の指が、かすかに震えている。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Then they were pretending to be dead!?”
“Of course not. I’m not so weakened that I’d miss something like that. But I can’t deny I let my guard down. I didn’t stay to see them crumble into ash.”
Another inch.
The circle tightens.
My fingers tremble faintly around the knife.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Then were they only pretending to be dead……!?"
"Of course not.
I'm not weakened enough to be fooled by such tricks.
…… But, the fact that I made a mistake can't be excused.
I didn't make sure they dissolved into ashes at the end."
Shuffle.
They close the circle around us.
My fingers grasping my knife tremble a bit.

lines.japanese:
はっきりいって、ここにいるどの死者からも重圧は感じない。
　ネロっていう怪物に比べれば、こんな連中はカカシと言ってさえいい。
―――けれど、五人。
　俺は、こんな多くの死者を―――もともとは人間だったモノを、相手にすることが出来るのか。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
Honestly, none of them exerts any pressure at all.
Beside the monster called Nrvnqsr, they might as well be scarecrows.
―――But there are five.
Can I truly face this many of the Dead—things that were once human beings?

lines.mirrorMoon:
To be blunt, there's no pressure coming from these Dead.
Compared to a monster like Nrvnqsr, they're practically nothing.
---But, five of them.
Can I fight this many Dead---this many things who were once human?

lines.japanese:
「――志貴、ためらえば死ぬのよ。
こいつらはもう生き物じゃない。
吸血鬼に血を吸われ、死者となったあとにわたしに二度目の生も無に帰されて――それでも無くなる事を許されずに使役される、ただの人形。
これを殺すことは罪ではないわ」
　背中越しにアルクェイドの声が聞こえる。
　いつのまにか、無防備な俺の背中にまわりこんでくれていたらしい。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hesitate and you die, Shiki. These things are no longer alive. A vampire drained their blood and made them members of the Dead; then I erased their second lives as well. Even so, they were denied oblivion and forced into service as puppets. There is no sin in killing them.”
Arcueid’s voice comes from behind me.
Without my noticing, she has moved to guard my exposed back.
lines.mao_english:
“Hesitate and you die, Shiki. These things are no longer alive. A vampire drained their blood and made them members of the Dead; then I erased their second lives as well. Even so, they were denied oblivion and forced into service as puppets. There is no sin in killing them.”
Arcueid’s voice comes from behind me.
Without my noticing, she has moved to guard my exposed back.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"--Shiki, if you hesitate you'll die.
They are no longer alive.
Once they have their blood sucked by a vampire and become The Dead, they can no longer return--they are just dolls used by the vampire.
There's no sin in killing them."
I hear her voice from behind me.
It seems she moved to protect my vulnerable back.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Arcueid says these people became Dead, then had even that second life annihilated by her, yet were not permitted to disappear and are now being operated as dolls. mirror moon omits her prior destruction and their forced post-destruction reanimation, precisely the anomaly explaining why last night's corpses are attacking again.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: The Dead's destroyed second life and forced reanimation are deleted

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってくれ。
どういう事だよ、それ」
「……世界には亡骸を操る魔術は多いっていうこと。
人間の死体っていうのは動物や無形のものより魔力を込めやすいから便利に使われるものなんだけど―――ざんねん、詳しく説明する余裕はないみたい。
　来るわよ、こいつら」
　アルクェイドの気配が離れる。
　同時に、死者たちが襲いかかってきた。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Wait. What does that mean?”
“It means there are many kinds of magecraft that manipulate corpses. Human bodies are easier to fill with magical energy than animals or formless things, so they’re useful. Unfortunately, I don’t think we have time for the full explanation.
Here they come.”
Arcueid moves away.
At once, the Dead attack.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Wait.
What do you mean?"
"…… I mean there are many ways to magically control a dead body.
It's easier to infuse a human corpse with magical energy than animals or intangible objects, so it's very convenient---unfortunately, I don't have time to go over the details.
They're coming."
I sense her moving away.
At the same time, they attack.

死のカタチが、襲いかかってくる。
　両手をあげて、ただ無造作に飛びかかってくる。
「――――くっ！」
　大きく横に跳んで、死者の突進をやりすごす。
　と、背後にイヤな気配を感じた。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
Shapes of death rush me, arms raised,
simply hurling themselves forward.
“—Damn!”
I leap aside and let the first one pass.
Then I feel something foul behind me.

lines.mirrorMoon:

They simply fly forward, arms outstretched.
"----K!"
I take a huge leap to the side and evade their attack.
Then, I sense something terrible behind me.

　そこには同じように、無造作に殴りかかってこようとする死者がいた。
――――死者の体には、『線』がない個所がないぐらいに死が満ちている。
　故に、どこを狙ってもナイフはたやすく彼らの肉体を切断するだろう。
　しかも死者の動きは緩慢だ。
　ネロが出してきた、どんなケモノよりも劣っている。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“You… bastard…!”
I spin with all my strength.
Another of the Dead stands there, taking a careless swing at me.
――――Their bodies are so saturated with death
that there is nowhere without a “line.”
Wherever I aim, the knife should part their flesh with ease.
And they are slow—slower than any beast Nrvnqsr ever loosed upon me.
lines.mao_english:
“You… bastard…!”

Another of the Dead stands there, taking a careless swing at me.
――――Their bodies are so saturated with death
that there is nowhere without a “line.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Why---you……!"
I whirl around with all my strength.
There, one of The Dead is trying to punch me.
----The Dead's body is almost devoid of places without "lines".
Which lets me slice anywhere on it's body.
What's more, it's movements are incredibly sluggish.
Far easier than anything that came out of Nrvnqsr.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「――――――」
　死者が襲いかかってくる。
　彼らは、簡単に、殺せる。
　振り上げられた腕をかわして、その無防備な左下腹部。
　『線』という血管が蠢く中にある、
　『点』という心臓を直視する――――
「く―――そぉ………！！！！」
　ざくん、という音。
　ナイフは、死者の左下腹部ではなく、振り上げられた腕だけを切断した。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“……”
One attacks.
I can kill it easily.
I slip beneath its raised arm. The left side of its abdomen lies open.
Amid the writhing blood vessels of the “lines,” I
stare directly at the heart called the “point”—
“Damn… it!”
The knife bites.
Instead of striking the lower abdomen, I sever only the raised arm.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"------"
The Dead charge me.
I can kill them with ease.
Evading the swinging arm, I aim for the first one's unprotected lower left abdomen.
In the "line" of blood vessels there.
I stare at the heart called its "point"----
"Damn---it……!!!!"
Thrash.
The knife doesn't reach it's target, only slicing through its upraised arm.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
片腕になった死者は、なんら躊躇うことなく襲いかかってくる。
　もう一人の死者も、恐れることなくやってくる。
　片腕の死者が襲いかかってくる。
　それをやり過ごした隙をついて、もう一人の死者が後ろから覆い被さってきた。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
The one-armed corpse attacks without an instant’s hesitation.
Another comes behind it, equally without fear.
The one-armed creature lunges.
As I evade it, the second drops onto my back.
lines.mao_english:
The one-armed corpse attacks without an instant’s hesitation.
Another comes behind it, equally without fear.
The one-armed creature lunges.
As I evade it, the second drops onto my back.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The one-armed Dead doesn't even pause its attack.
The other Dead also comes in showing no fear.
The one-armed Dead attacks.
Right when I evade that Dead, the other Dead jumps on me from behind.
lines.mirror_moon:
The one-armed Dead doesn't even pause its attack.
The other Dead also comes in showing no fear.
The one-armed Dead attacks.
Right when I evade that Dead, the other Dead jumps on me from behind.

lines.japanese:
「あ――――」
　ごりっ。
　後ろから、こちらにおんぶをする姿勢になって。
　死者は、俺の首筋に噛みついてきた。
　血を吸うとか、そういった行為じゃない。
　これは動物が獲物を即死させるために、首を噛みきろうとする行為と同じだ。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah—” Crunch.
Clinging to my back like a rider,
it bites into the side of my neck.
This is not an attempt to drink blood.
It is the way an animal bites through
its prey’s neck to kill it instantly.
lines.mao_english:

it bites into the side of my neck.
This is not an attempt to drink blood.
It is the way an animal bites through
its prey’s neck to kill it instantly.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
Grind.
From behind, like a piggy-back stance.
The Dead bites on my neck.
Not to suck my blood or anything like that.
Just like a beast trying to kill its prey by biting its neck off.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ah----"
Grind.
From behind, like a piggy-back stance.
The Dead bites on my neck.
Not to suck my blood or anything like that.
Just like a beast trying to kill its prey by biting its neck off.

lines.japanese:
「ぐっ――――！」
　人間の口で首筋を噛みきれるものなのだろうか。
　食い込んだ死者の口は浅い。
奥歯ではなく前歯で噛みついてきている。
　結果、ぱきっと音をたてて、死者の歯のほうが折れた。
　それでも―――まったいらになった口で、死者はこちらの首を噛みきろうとしてくる。
　痛みはあまりない。
　ただ、おぞましかった。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
Can a human mouth truly bite through a neck?
The corpse has caught me shallowly with its front teeth rather than its molars.
Something cracks; its teeth break first.
Even so, it keeps gnawing at my neck with its flattened mouth.
It barely hurts.
It is simply revolting.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Gah----!"
Can a human mouth bite through a neck?
The Dead's mouth is shallow.
It bites with its front teeth rather than its back.
As a result, The Dead's teeth actually break off.
Even still---it tries to bite through my neck with its flat mouth.
It doesn't really hurt.
It's just disgusting.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「あ……あ、あ―――」
　前からは片腕の死者が歩いてくる。
　とにかく、後ろからしがみついた死者を殺さなければ、殺されてしまう。
　方法はたやすい。
　いまだ噛みきろうと無駄な行為を続けている死者の顔を、さっくりとナイフで切断すればいいだけの話だから。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah…
ah…
aaah—” The one-armed corpse advances from the front.
Unless I kill the thing on my back, it will kill me.
The method is simple: draw the knife across the face that is still uselessly worrying at my neck.
lines.mao_english:
“Ah…
ah…
aaah—” The one-armed corpse advances from the front.
Unless I kill the thing on my back, it will kill me.
The method is simple: draw the knife across the face that is still uselessly worrying at my neck.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah…… ah, ah---"
The one-armed dead walks toward me.
I have to kill The Dead behind me or I'll die.
The method is simple.
As it tries to continue biting my neck, I can just slice my knife through its face.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ah…… ah, ah---"
The one-armed dead walks toward me.
I have to kill The Dead behind me or I'll die.
The method is simple.
As it tries to continue biting my neck, I can just slice my knife through its face.

lines.japanese:
「――――――」
　でも―――それは、人を殺すということだ。
　わかってる。
　彼らはもう人間じゃないって、生きてさえいないんだってわかってるのに―――それは、いけない気がするんだ。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“……”
But that would mean killing a person.
I know they are no longer human.
I know they are not even alive. Yet it still feels wrong.
lines.mao_english:
“……”
But that would mean killing a person.
I know they are no longer human.
I know they are not even alive. Yet it still feels wrong.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------"
But---that means I am going to kill.
I understand.
They aren't human, they aren't even living---but I still feel it's wrong.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------"
But---that means I am going to kill.
I understand.
They aren't human, they aren't even living---but I still feel it's wrong.

lines.japanese:
―――なんて甘さ。
　たとえ死人だとしても。
　人のカタチをしたもの、そうやって動いているものを。
　同じ人間である俺が殺してしまうのは、何か、決定的に間違っている気がして――――
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
―――What pathetic softness.
Dead or not, they have human shapes.
They move like human beings.
For me, another human, to kill them feels decisively, irreparably wrong—
lines.mao_english:
―――What pathetic softness.
Dead or not, they have human shapes.
They move like human beings.
For me, another human, to kill them feels decisively, irreparably wrong—
lines.mirrorMoon:
---How naive.
Even if they are corpses.
They have the shapes of humans, and they move like them.
It still seems mistaken to kill them as another human being----
lines.mirror_moon:
---How naive.
Even if they are corpses.
They have the shapes of humans, and they move like them.
It still seems mistaken to kill them as another human being----

lines.japanese:
「志貴―――！？」
　遠くで、死者たち三人を相手にしているアルクェイドの声がした。
　思わず、もう目の前に死者がいるっていうのに、声の方向に視線を移す。
―――と。
　そこには、信じがたい光景が広がっていた。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki!?”
Arcueid calls from a distance, where she is fighting the other three.
Though a corpse is already before me, I turn toward her voice.
―――And see something
impossible.
lines.mao_english:
“Shiki!?”

―――And see something
impossible.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki---!?"
I hear Arcueid's voice as she deals with the other three Dead.
Without thinking, despite the one in front of me, I look over at her.
---And.
I see something terribly unbelievable.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Shiki---!?"
I hear Arcueid's voice as she deals with the other three Dead.
Without thinking, despite the one in front of me, I look over at her.
---And.
I see something terribly unbelievable.

lines.japanese:
「―――――」
　アルクェイドが、傷を負ってる。
　あんな緩慢な動きの、あいつだったらそれこそ一秒とかからずに仕留めてしまうような死者たち相手に、アルクェイドが追いこまれている。
　彼女の呼吸は荒い。
　足取りもおぼつかなくて、あんな―――俺でさえ簡単にやりすごせる死者の一撃を、まともにくらっている。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“……”
Arcueid is wounded.
These creatures are so slow that she should destroy them in less than a second, yet they are driving her back.
Her breathing is ragged, her steps unsteady.
Even blows I could evade with ease are striking her cleanly.
lines.mao_english:
“……”
Arcueid is wounded.
These creatures are so slow that she should destroy them in less than a second, yet they are driving her back.
Her breathing is ragged, her steps unsteady.
Even blows I could evade with ease are striking her cleanly.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
Arcueid is wounded.
Even though they move so sluggishly and would only take her a second to kill, Arcueid is being pushed by those Dead.
She breathes heavily.
Her footwork is also unsteady---and she's having difficulty evading those attacks even I can evade.
lines.mirror_moon:
"-----"
Arcueid is wounded.
Even though they move so sluggishly and would only take her a second to kill, Arcueid is being pushed by those Dead.

lines.japanese:
どん、と死者の腕がアルクェイドの腕を引き裂く。
　アルクェィドの反撃。
　彼女は傷つけられた反動で死者の体を頭から腰まで、強引に二つに裂いた。
　地面に二つになって崩れ落ちる死者。
　同時に―――死者にわだかまっていた黒い死の波が、アルクェイドに乗り移っていく。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
A corpse’s arm rips open Arcueid’s arm.
She retaliates with the force of the impact,
ripping its body apart from head to waist.
The two halves collapse to the ground.
At that same instant, the black tide of death pooled inside it pours into Arcueid.
lines.mao_english:

She retaliates with the force of the impact,
ripping its body apart from head to waist.
The two halves collapse to the ground.
At that same instant, the black tide of death pooled inside it pours into Arcueid.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The Dead rips into her arm.
She counters.
She tears the body in two from the head to its waist.
Both halves crumble to the ground.
At the same time---the other waiting shades of death pounce on her.

lines.japanese:
「ア―――」
　がたり、とアルクェイドはひざまずいた。
　ここからでも解るぐらい、はあはあと呼吸を荒だたせて。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah—” Arcueid drops heavily to her knees,
panting hard enough for
me to hear from here.
lines.mao_english:
“Ah—” Arcueid drops heavily to her knees,
panting hard enough for
me to hear from here.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"A---"
With a crash she lands on her knees.
I can tell she's breathing wildly from this distance.
lines.mirror_moon:
"A---"

I can tell she's breathing wildly from this distance.

lines.japanese:
そこへ―――二人の死者が襲いかかった。
　ひざまずいて動けないアルクェイドの顔を蹴りつけて、地面に倒れこませる。
「や―――」
　そのあとに、連中は。
　表情がないくせに、下卑た笑いをうかべて、アルクェイドの体にのしかかった。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
The remaining two fall upon her.
They kick her in the face while she kneels helplessly, knocking her to the ground.
“No—”
Then, though their faces hold no expression,
they wear leering smiles as they throw themselves on top of her.
lines.mao_english:

“No—”

they wear leering smiles as they throw themselves on top of her.
lines.mirrorMoon:
There---the two Dead attack.

They kick her kneeling figure in the face and makes her collapse on the ground.
"St---"
After that,
they carry a dull, expressionless smile as they get on top of her.
lines.mirror_moon:

they carry a dull, expressionless smile as they get on top of her.

lines.japanese:
「やめ―――」
　……十字架に張りつけるみたいに。
　昨日の夜、俺が、そうして彼女を陵辱した時みたいに。
「やめろ、てめえら―――！」
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Stop—”
…They pin her as though to a cross.
Just as I pinned her when I raped her last night.
“Get off her, you bastards!”
lines.mao_english:
“Stop—”
…They pin her as though to a cross.
Just as I pinned her when I raped her last night.
“Get off her, you bastards!”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Stop---"
…… She lies there arms outspread like a cross.
Like when I did those disgraceful things to her last night.
"Stop it, you fucking bastards---!"
lines.mirror_moon:
"Stop---"
…… She lies there arms outspread like a cross.
Like when I did those disgraceful things to her last night.
"Stop it, you fucking bastards---!"

lines.japanese:
トスン。
　後ろから噛みついてきていた死者の顔を切断する。
　俺の目の前でなぜか停止していた死者の左下腹部を突く。
　そこが死者の『死』だ。
　ざあ、と音をたてて崩れ落ちる死者を見る事もせず、振り返って顔のない死者も、殺した。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
Thk.
I slice through the face of the corpse biting me from behind.
I stab the lower-left abdomen of the other, which has inexplicably stopped before me.
That is where its “death” lies.
Without watching it collapse into ash, I turn and kill the faceless one as well.
lines.mao_english:
Thk.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Stab.
I cut through the face of the one behind me still trying to bite me.
I pierce the lower right abdomen of the one in front of me which had strangely paused.
That's where its "death" is.
Not even looking at it as it crumbles away, I turn around and kill the faceless Dead behind me.

I run.
The corpses pinning Arcueid notice me, rise, and charge.
“……”
There is no difficulty now.
As each reaches me, I cut through its “point” of death.
lines.mao_english:

The ones around her realize I'm coming and get up and attack.
"-----"
No problem.
I slice through their "points" of death as they attack me.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「は―――――あ」
　全て終わって。
　ようやく、呼吸が戻ってきた。
「は―――あ」
　目の前には灰になっていく人型が四体。
　アルクェイドが仕留めたものをいれれば五体か。
lines.label: s187
lines.maoEnglish:
“Haaah…”
When it is all over,
my breath finally returns.
“Hah…”
Four human shapes are turning to ash before me.
Five, counting the one Arcueid destroyed.
lines.mao_english:

"Gha---ah."

lines.maoEnglish:
“Ha…”
I killed them. I ended them without hesitation.
“Ha… ah.”
I cannot think straight. Regret, self-reproach—all those things must be tearing at me.

　その姿は、学校で何気なく出会っていた先輩と何ひとつ違わない。
―――そのせいだろうか。
　依然として状況はまったく掴めないけど、気分だけは冷静になってくれた。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
Ciel looked up at me almost timidly.
She seemed no different from the girl I had encountered so casually at school.
―――Perhaps that was why.
I still understood nothing about the situation, but at least my mind began to settle.
lines.mao_english:

―――Perhaps that was why.
I still understood nothing about the situation, but at least my mind began to settle.
lines.mirrorMoon:
She looks up hesitantly.
This is the leisurely Senpai I know from school.
---Is that why?
Even though I still can't grasp the situation, I start to calm down.

lines.japanese:
「……突然のことですから遠野くんがわたしのことを敵視するのは覚悟しています。
けど、どうしても話さなくちゃいけない事があるんです。
　その、こんなふうに拘束してしまって、ごめんなさい」
　先輩はふかぶかと頭をさげる。
　……おかしな格好をして物騒な物を持っているけど、先輩はやっぱり先輩のままだ。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…I knew this sudden revelation might make you regard me as an enemy. But there are things I must tell you.
And… I’m sorry for restraining you like this.”
Ciel bowed deeply.
…The clothes were strange and the objects in her hands dangerous, but she was still Ciel.

"…… This is abrupt so I am prepared for you to hate me.
But I have something I have to tell you.
I'm very sorry for restraining you like this."
Senpai bows her head.
…… She's dressed strange, but Senpai is still Senpai.

lines.japanese:
「―――いいよ。
怒ってないからそんな謝らないでくれ。
先輩には一度助けられてるし、こっちだって聞きたい事があるんだから」
「―――そう言ってもらえると助かります。
……けど、遠野くんがわたしに聞きたいことってなんですか？」
「……あのね。
そんなの決まってるだろ、先輩はいったいどんな人なのかなってコト。
　そんな格好してるし、アルクェイドをふっ飛ばしてけろりとしてるし、学校で先輩のことを覚えてるのは俺だけだし」
　はあ、と先輩は拍子ぬけしたような返事をする。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“—It’s fine. I’m not angry, so don’t apologize like that. You’ve already saved me once, and I have questions of my own.”
“—That is a relief. …But what did you want to ask me?”
“Come on. Obviously, I want to know who you really are.
You’re dressed like that, you blasted Arcueid away without blinking, and I’m the only person at school who even remembers you.”
“Oh,” Ciel replied, sounding oddly deflated.

"…… Um, isn't it obvious?
Just who are you, Senpai?
Dressed like that and smashing away Arcueid, and I'm the only one who remembers you at school."
Senpai gives a sigh in response.

lines.japanese:
「それじゃあ聞きますけど、遠野くんはわたしの事をどう思ってるんですか？」
「……うん。
俺もアルクェイドから聞いただけでよくは知らないんだけど、教会っていうところのひとじゃないかなって」
「そうですね。
遠野くんの思っているとおり、わたしは教会のエクソシストで吸血鬼専門のお仕事についています。
　それ以上のことは答えられませんけど、遠野くんにとってはそれだけで十分だと思います」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“Then let me ask you first. What do you think I am, Tohno?”
“…I only know what Arcueid told me, but I thought you might belong to something called the Church.”
“That is correct. Just as you suspected, I am an exorcist of the Holy Church, assigned specifically to vampires.
I cannot tell you more than that, but for your purposes it should be enough.”

"Then let me ask.
Tohno-kun, what do you think about me?"
"…… Hm.
I've only heard some things from Arcueid, about The Church and stuff."
"That's right.
As you know, I am an exorcist of The Church.
My specialty is hunting vampires.
I can't answer anything else, but I think that is enough for you."

えっと……そうですね、ちょうどわたしのしたい話と重なるので、ここからはわたしが質問をしましょうか」

“Enough? Then why was someone like you attending my school? If hunting vampires is your specialty, shouldn’t you have been searching the city like Arcueid?”
“No, as it happens, I did have a reason for going to your school. Um… yes, that brings me right around to what I wanted to tell you, so how about I ask the questions from here?”

……その、人の血を吸って領地を広げていくっていう、旧いタイプの吸血鬼だって聞いてるけど」
lines.label: s189

「吸血鬼は大きく二種類に分けられる、という事は知ってるんですね。
なら彼らが不完全な不老不死だっていう事は聞いてると思うんですけど―――」
「聞いてるよ。
人間の血を吸わなくちゃ体が保てないって。
けど、逆に人間の血を吸っている分にはずっと老いずに生きていられるんだろ？」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“Then you know vampires fall into two broad categories. I assume she also told you that their ageless immortality is incomplete—”
“She did. They need human blood to maintain their bodies. But as long as they keep drinking it, they can live without growing old, right?”

lines.maoEnglish:
“Yes. But that cannot truly be called ageless immortality. Some of them cannot maintain themselves on blood alone, and others are disposed of by people like us.
Anything capable of ‘dying’ in those ways is not immortal.”

Besides, there are ones for whom drinking blood does not maintain their body fully, and there are some that are exterminated by us.
You can't call something that can die like that immortal."

lines.maoEnglish:
“…Fine, but I’d appreciate it if you could keep the summary as short as possible.”
“…Would you? Very well. I’ll give you a crisp, concise explanation.”
For some reason, Ciel looked disappointed.
“Then I will be as brief as possible. The ageless immortality of vampires classified as Dead Apostles is extremely unstable.
In practical terms, their lifespans have merely become several times longer than a human being’s.”

「……質問。
あいつら、寿命だけじゃなくて力とかも人間離れしてるけど、それは関係ないの？」
「基本的には無関係です。
死徒の固有能力は彼らが人間だったころに手に入れたモノを、そのまま何百年と成長させたものですから。
　彼らは自身が学んだものを吸血鬼になっても学び続けていて、結果としてそれが超越した現象に昇華されているんです」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Question. Their strength is inhuman too. Isn’t that related?”
“Fundamentally, no. A Dead Apostle’s unique powers are things they acquired while human and continued developing for hundreds of years.
They persist in studying whatever discipline they once pursued. In time, the result is elevated into a transcendent phenomenon.”

Continuing their studies from their human lives gives them these extraordinary powers."

今いった『学んでいたもの』が一人一人違うのもそのためです。

そんな死徒たちの中に、真剣に不老不死を学んでいたモノがいたんです」

こんな不完全なものはいらない、自分はもっと完全な不老不死を作り上げるって」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Every Dead Apostle pursues a different purpose. That is why the discipline each of them cultivated is different.
And among them, there was one who devoted himself earnestly to the study of immortality.”
“…He became immortal, then researched immortality?”
“Yes. Dead Apostles recognize that becoming vampires has brought them to the highest immortality possible in a human body.
But he considered it a form of degeneration. He rejected such an imperfect state and resolved to create a more perfect immortality.”

"……?

"Yes.
The instant the Dead Apostles become vampires, they assume they have reached the limit of immortality as humans.
However, he felt that it was just a degeneration.
He did not want something so imperfect, and he wanted to come up with a more perfect immortality."

lines.japanese:
「ですが、こうしてカタチがある以上滅びは必然です。
時間の圧迫はいかなる存在にも例外はありません。
　吸血鬼たちは、その圧迫に耐えられる強度が人間より大きく設定されている、というだけなんです。
　生命は、生まれでた時点で死を内包しています。
　自分がここに存る以上、たとえ歳をとらない肉体をもってしまっても、その死から逃れる事はできない。
　死から逃れる、という事は死ぬ、ということ。
　この絶対の矛盾は、どうしても解決できない問題です」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“But anything that possesses form must inevitably perish. No being is exempt from the pressure of time.
Vampires are simply made strong enough to withstand that pressure longer than humans. Life contains death from the instant it is born. So long as the self exists here, even an ageless body cannot escape that death.
To escape death is itself to die.
That absolute contradiction cannot be resolved.”
lines.mao_english:
“But anything that possesses form must inevitably perish. No being is exempt from the pressure of time.
Vampires are simply made strong enough to withstand that pressure longer than humans. Life contains death from the instant it is born. So long as the self exists here, even an ageless body cannot escape that death.
To escape death is itself to die.
That absolute contradiction cannot be resolved.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"But, as long as something has shape, it cannot but perish.
There isn't anything that can withstand the passage of time.
Vampires merely have a resistance higher than that of humans.
Anything living internalizes death the moment it is born.
Even if in possession of a body which does not age, as long as it exists, it cannot escape death.
To escape death is to die.
This contradiction is a problem that cannot be solved."

Everyone has death within them.
If there is someone who doesn't, then that's---"

There can't be anything that cannot die in this world.

lines.japanese:
「そういったわけなんですけど、そのカレはそれじゃあ死んだ後も自己が存在し続けていれば不老不死なんじゃないかって行きついたんです。
　……わたしたちの教義にはありませんけど、輪廻転生というヤツですね。
　今の自分が死んでも、自分を保存できたままで新しい人間としてやり直す事ができれば、それは死を先駆けていますから。
　……まあ、もっとも消滅していない時点で死ではないので死の先を行く、というわけではありませんけど」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“And so he arrived at the idea that if the self continued to exist after the body’s death, that might qualify as immortality.
…Our doctrine does not recognize it, but you would call the process reincarnation.
If the present self dies yet can preserve itself intact and begin again as a new human being, then it has outrun death.
…Though since the self was never annihilated, it did not truly die and therefore cannot be said to have passed beyond death.”
lines.mao_english:
“And so he arrived at the idea that if the self continued to exist after the body’s death, that might qualify as immortality.
…Our doctrine does not recognize it, but you would call the process reincarnation.
If the present self dies yet can preserve itself intact and begin again as a new human being, then it has outrun death.
…Though since the self was never annihilated, it did not truly die and therefore cannot be said to have passed beyond death.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's the reason, but he concluded that if he could preserve his existence after death, then he would be immortal.
…… It isn't in our doctrine, but it's what you call reincarnation.
Even if you die, if you could preserve your sense of self and start over again as a new human, that would be eluding death.
…… Well, when he isn't completely annihilated, he isn't dead, so it's actually not quite eluding death."

lines.japanese:
「輪廻転生って―――ようするに、死んだらまた赤ん坊からやり直すっていうこと？」
「そうです。
存命している間に、次の自分の肉体をあらかじめ決めておいて、その赤子が誕生した時点で“自分”の全情報を移植する。
　カレの情報はその赤子が成人、ないし自己としての知性を持つまで影を潜めています。
“自分”を引き継ぐに相応しい知性をもった段階で、その赤子はカレという吸血鬼になってしまうんです」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Reincarnation—so after he dies, he starts over as a baby?”
“Precisely. While still alive, he chooses the body that will become his next self. The moment that child is born, every piece of information constituting ‘him’ is transplanted into it.
His information remains dormant until the child reaches adulthood—or at least develops an independent intelligence.
Once the child possesses an intellect fit to inherit ‘him,’ it becomes the vampire he was.”

“Reincarnation—so after he dies, he starts over as a baby?”

"Yes.

His information stays deep within the baby until it matures, or until it gains its intelligence as its own.
As soon as that baby has the intelligence to succeed 'his self', the baby becomes a new vampire that is him."

lines.japanese:
「さきほどは“全情報”といいましたけど、解りやすく言えば魂ですね。
　魂が大気を伝搬して他者に乗り移る、なんていうのは実感が湧かないでしょうけど、ようするに電波と同じなんです。
この場合、電波を発信するのも受信するのも人間の脳。
　カレの優れたところは、魂なんていう計測不能にして、肉体という器から離れたら霧散してしまうモノを、伝達可能なモノとして加工したことでしょう」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“I called it ‘all his information,’ but in simpler terms, it is his soul.
The idea of a soul traveling through the air and possessing another person may be difficult to imagine, but it resembles a radio signal. In this case, human brains serve as both transmitter and receiver.
His achievement was to process the soul—something immeasurable that normally disperses once separated from the vessel of the body—into a form that could be transmitted.”
lines.mao_english:
“I called it ‘all his information,’ but in simpler terms, it is his soul.
The idea of a soul traveling through the air and possessing another person may be difficult to imagine, but it resembles a radio signal. In this case, human brains serve as both transmitter and receiver.
His achievement was to process the soul—something immeasurable that normally disperses once separated from the vessel of the body—into a form that could be transmitted.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"I said all of 'his information' earlier, but to use simpler terms, think of it as his 'soul'.
It wouldn't be quite correct to say his soul propagates through the air and takes over someone's body, but it's similar to an electromagnetic wave.
In this case, the human brain is what does the transmitting and the receiving.
His exceptional point is that he took this soul, which is incalculable and something that disperses as soon as it leaves the envelope of the body, and processed it as something that could be transmitted."

…I did not know why,
but like Arcueid, she appeared to harbor some private hatred for this enemy.

Ciel showed no alarm.
She only watched me with something almost like pity.

lines.japanese:
「あ―――」
「わたしから聞かせたかった話はそれだけです。
あとは遠野くんの判断にお任せします」
「お任せしますって、先輩の話だと俺は―――」
「……ほんとのことを言ってしまうと、わたしにもわかりません。
遠野くんはすごく平凡で、どこにでもいるような学生さんです。
だからきっと、わたしの勘はおおはずれしてますよ。
　だって―――遠野くんは、わたしみたいな所にいちゃいけない人なんだから」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah—”
“That is everything I needed to tell you. What you do now is for you to decide.”
“Decide? According to what you just said, I’m—”
“…To tell you the truth, I don’t know either. You are an utterly ordinary student, the sort one might meet anywhere. I’m sure my intuition has simply failed me.
Because—you are someone who should never belong in the world where I live.”
lines.mao_english:

Because—you are someone who should never belong in the world where I live.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah---"
"That is all I had to tell you.
I'll leave the rest for you to decide, Tohno-kun."
"Leave it to me?
But according to your story, I---"
"…… To be honest, I don't know either.
You are an incredibly ordinary person, like a student you could find anywhere.
My intuition has to be wrong.
Because---you are someone who shouldn't be in a world like mine."

lines.japanese:
どこか悲しそうな笑顔で、先輩はぴょこん、と俺から大きく距離をとった。
　まるでこの先はもう他人ですよって告げているみたいな、手の届かない、遠い距離。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
With a sad little smile, Ciel hopped far away from me.
It was an unreachable distance, as though she were declaring that from this moment on, we were strangers.
lines.mao_english:
With a sad little smile, Ciel hopped far away from me.
It was an unreachable distance, as though she were declaring that from this moment on, we were strangers.
lines.mirrorMoon:
With a sad smile, Senpai leaps an incredible distance from me.
As if trying to tell me she's someone else now, an unreachable, far distance.

lines.japanese:
「―――――」
　俺は―――やっぱり、アルクェイドを放っておけない。
　今からでも走ってあいつを追いかけないと、本当にもう二度と、あいつとは出会えない気がする。
「彼女を追いかけるんですか、遠野くん」
　先輩の声は、アルクェイドを追い詰めていた時のものに戻っている。
　抑揚のない、感情が希薄な声に。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“—”
I still could not abandon Arcueid.
If I did not run after her now, I felt that I would truly never see her again.
“You intend to follow her, Tohno?”
Ciel’s voice had returned to the one she used while
cornering Arcueid—flat and nearly empty of emotion.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
I---still can't leave Arcueid alone.
Unless I chase after her now, I feel like I'll never see her again.
"You're going after her, Tohno-kun?"
Senpai's voice returns to the way it was when she drove off Arcueid.
An inflectionless voice devoid of emotion.

lines.japanese:
「―――うん。
先輩が教会っていうところの人で、アルクェイドが敵なんだっていうのはわかるけど。
　今は色々あって、俺とあいつは協力しあってるんだ。
だから、探さないと。
あいつを一人にしておくと何しでかすかわからないしね」
　冗談っぽく笑って、それじゃあと先輩に背を向けた。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“—Yeah. I understand that you belong to the Church and that Arcueid is your enemy.
But a lot has happened, and right now she and I are partners. I have to find her. Who knows what she’ll do if I leave her alone?”
I gave Ciel a joking smile, said goodbye, and turned my back.
lines.mao_english:
“—Yeah. I understand that you belong to the Church and that Arcueid is your enemy.
But a lot has happened, and right now she and I are partners. I have to find her. Who knows what she’ll do if I leave her alone?”
I gave Ciel a joking smile, said goodbye, and turned my back.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---Yeah.
Because you're a person of The Church, I know she's an enemy of yours.
But a lot of things have happened and I agreed to help her, so I have to look for her.
I don't know what she'll do if I leave her by herself."
Laughing as if it was a joke, I tell her "Later" and turn around.

lines.japanese:
「―――待ってください。
彼女を追ってもあなたは殺されるだけです。
アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドとは、もうこれ以上会ってはいけません」
「殺されるだけって―――まあ、先輩は信じてくれないかもしれないけど、アルクェイドは本当に血を吸わないんだ。
あいつ、わりといいヤツなんだって」
「……知っています。
たしかに彼女は人間の血を吸う事はなかったでしょう。
けれど、それももうおしまいです。
一度吸血衝動に負けた真祖は、堕ちていくだけなんですから」
　ぴたり、と足が止まる。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“—Wait. If you follow her, she will only kill you. You must never see Arcueid Brunestud again.”
“Kill me? You may not believe it, but Arcueid really doesn’t drink blood. She’s actually a decent person.”
“…I know. It is true that she has never drunk human blood. But that is over now. Once a True Ancestor succumbs to the vampiric impulse, there is nothing left but the fall.”
I stopped dead.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---Please wait.
If you go after her you will only get killed.
You must not see Arcueid Brunestud again."
"Only get killed?---Well, you may not believe me, but she really doesn't suck blood.
She's quite a good person, actually."
"…… I know.
Certainly she hasn't drunk human blood.
However, that's at an end.
A True Ancestor who gives in to the vampiric impulse once can only fall downward from there."
My feet freeze in place.

lines.japanese:
「……先輩？
　真祖って――吸血衝動って、どういうこと？」
「……ですから、血を吸いたいという欲求です。
　遠野くん。
死徒と呼ばれる吸血鬼は、その大半が吸血鬼に血を吸われて吸血鬼となったものです。
彼らは自らの劣化していく肉体を補うために、人間の血を必要とします。
　いわば、彼らの吸血行為は生きるためにはどうしても避けられないものです」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Ciel? True Ancestor—vampiric impulse—what are you talking about?”
“…The desire to drink blood.
Most vampires called Dead Apostles were once humans who became vampires after another vampire drank their blood. They require human blood to replenish their decaying bodies.
For them, drinking blood is unavoidable if they wish to survive.”
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai?
True Ancestor--vampiric impulse, what do you mean?"
"…… I mean the desire to drink blood.
Tohno-kun.
The vampires called Dead Apostles mostly became vampires after a vampire sucked their blood.
To preserve their bodies they need the blood of humans.
In other words, they can't escape drinking blood if they want to live."

lines.japanese:
「ですが初めから吸血鬼だったモノ達は違います。
　……死徒は、たとえ吸血鬼だとしても元々はわたしたちと同じ人間だったもの。
言うなればまだヒトと呼べるかもしれません。
　けれど、生まれた時から吸血種として生まれたモノは、はたしてヒトと呼べるんでしょうか？」
「な―――なにを、言ってるんだよ先輩。
俺が聞いているのはアルクェイドのことじゃないか」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“But those born as vampires are different.
…However vampiric they may be, Dead Apostles were originally human beings like us. Perhaps they can still be called human.
But can something born as a member of a vampiric species truly be called human?”
“Wh-what are you talking about? I asked you about Arcueid.”

lines.mirrorMoon:

…… The Dead Apostles were originally humans like us.
So maybe you can still call them human.
However, if someone was born a vampire, can you call it human?"
"Wha---what are you saying, Senpai?
I'm asking about about Arcueid."

lines.japanese:
「ですから、これは彼女のことです。
　考えたことがない、とは言わせません。
　死徒が吸血鬼によって吸血鬼化するのなら。
　その根源、大本にあたる“初めから吸血鬼だった存在”がいるということを。
　この、そもそも生命としての系統樹がわたしたちと一致しない吸血種を真祖といいます。
　人間の血なんて必要なく、死徒たちと同等、いえそれ以上の超越能力をもつモノたち。
　彼女はその真祖と呼ばれる一族の王族なんです。
……彼らには身分階級がありませんから王族、というのは正しくはありませんけど」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“This is about her.
You cannot tell me the thought never occurred to you.
If vampires create more vampires by drinking human blood,
then there must be an origin—a being that was a vampire from the beginning.
Members of this vampiric species, whose phylogenetic tree is entirely separate from ours, are called True Ancestors.
They have no need of human blood and possess powers equal to, or greater than, those of the Dead Apostles.
She belongs to the royal line of the True Ancestors. …Though ‘royal’ is not strictly accurate, since they have no social ranks.”
lines.mao_english:

If Dead Apostles become vampires from vampires,
there has to be an origin, 'an existence that is a vampire from the beginning'.
These vampires that are a completely different species from us, we call the True Ancestors.
Those who don't need human blood and have special powers equivalent to, no, surpassing the Dead Apostles.
She is a member of the royal family of the True Ancestors.
…… although they don't really have any rank structure, so saying 'royal' isn't quite accurate."

lines.japanese:
「―――だからそれがどうしたっていうんだ先輩。
そんな話―――俺にはぜんぜん関係ないっ……！」
「ありますよ。
真祖と呼ばれる吸血種には、その下僕たる死徒たちよりはるかに業の深い吸血衝動があるんですから」
　先輩の目には何の感情もない。
　そこには、ただ鏡のように、ひどく動揺した俺の顔だけが映っていた。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“—What does any of that matter? None of it has anything to do with me…!”
“It has everything to do with you. The vampiric impulse burdening the True Ancestors runs far deeper than that of the Dead Apostles who serve them.”
Ciel’s eyes held no emotion.
Like mirrors, they reflected only my own badly shaken face.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---So what, Senpai?
This conversation---this doesn't have anything to do with me……!"
"It does.
These vampires known as the True Ancestors have a deeper impulse to drink blood than the Dead Apostles."
Her eyes are completely emotionless.
Like mirrors, they show my agitated face.

lines.japanese:
「いいですか、遠野くん。
真祖たちはもともと人間の血がなくても生存できるんです。
　けれど、その進化の過程でどんな間違いが起こったのか、それとも完璧な存在なんて無いという事からなのか、ともかく彼らにはただ当たり前のように人間の血が欲しくなる時期があります。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“Listen carefully, Tohno. True Ancestors can survive without human blood.
Yet whether through some flaw in their evolution, or simply because no perfect being can exist, there comes a time when they begin to desire human blood as naturally as breathing.”
lines.mao_english:
“Listen carefully, Tohno. True Ancestors can survive without human blood.
Yet whether through some flaw in their evolution, or simply because no perfect being can exist, there comes a time when they begin to desire human blood as naturally as breathing.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Do you see, Tohno-kun?
The True Ancestors can live without human blood.
However, maybe a mistake happened in their evolution, or maybe there's no such thing as a perfect existence, but anyway, there is a period when they desire the blood of humans.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……彼らに血を吸われた人間は、その時点で人間でなくなります。
　真祖と人間では生命としてのスケールが違いすぎるんです。
真祖という強大な生命と血を触れ合わせてしまった時点で、そのあまりの格差の前に人間は人間でいられなくなる。
　小さな波が触れるだけで大きな波に飲みこまれるように、人間はその真祖の分身――平たくいえば人形になってしまうんです」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…A human whose blood they drink ceases to be human at that instant.
As life-forms, True Ancestors exist on an entirely different scale from humans. The moment a human’s blood mingles with a True Ancestor’s, the vast disparity between them makes it impossible for the human to remain human.
Just as a small wave disappears into a greater one at the slightest touch, the person becomes an extension of the True Ancestor—put plainly, a puppet.”
lines.mao_english:
“…A human whose blood they drink ceases to be human at that instant.
As life-forms, True Ancestors exist on an entirely different scale from humans. The moment a human’s blood mingles with a True Ancestor’s, the vast disparity between them makes it impossible for the human to remain human.
Just as a small wave disappears into a greater one at the slightest touch, the person becomes an extension of the True Ancestor—put plainly, a puppet.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… The instant a human has his blood drunk by them, he no longer remains human.
True Ancestors are on a scale different from humans as creatures.
When the powerful life of a True Ancestor touches the blood of a human, the sheer difference means a human cannot remain human after such contact.
Like a small wave absorbed into a larger wave, that person becomes a part of the True Ancestor--to simplify, it becomes a doll."

lines.japanese:
「問題は、彼らの吸血衝動に理由がない、という事なんです。
　理由がないから止めようがない。
　真祖という完璧な生命が内包した欠点。
死に至る病、とでも言いましょうか。
　とにかく彼らは自らの“血を吸いたい”という衝動を抑えて生きています。
　それは理性で我慢をする、といったレベルの話ではありません。
　彼らは自身のあらゆる力を自分自身の欲望に対して使用して、力ずくで自身を封印しているんです。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“The problem is that their vampiric impulse has no cause.
With no cause, there is no way to stop it.
It is the flaw contained within the perfect life of a True Ancestor—a fatal illness, you might say.
They live by suppressing the desire to drink blood.
This is not a simple matter of resisting temptation through reason.
They turn every power they possess against their own desire and seal themselves by force.
lines.mao_english:
“The problem is that their vampiric impulse has no cause.

They live by suppressing the desire to drink blood.
This is not a simple matter of resisting temptation through reason.
They turn every power they possess against their own desire and seal themselves by force.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"The problem is, there's no reason for their vampiric impulses.
There's no reason, so there's no way to stop it.
The fatal flaw in an otherwise perfect existence.
You can call it a terminal illness.
Anyway, they live by resisting their urge to drink blood.
It isn't a matter of using the mind to put up with it.
They use all their powers to resist this urge and seal it within themselves by force.

lines.japanese:
「……自らの強大な力を自分自身に向けて使うことで、彼らは吸血衝動を抑えている。
　けれどもし――なんらかの外的要因でその真祖の能力が低下してしまった場合、抑えていた吸血衝動がどうなるかわかりますか？」
　……なんらかの外的要因で、自身の能力が低下した場合……？
　例えば、深い傷をうけてその治療に力を使ったり、一度、これ以上ないっていうぐらいにまで殺されて、蘇生するのに力を使ったりした、場合―――
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…By directing their immense power against themselves, they suppress the vampiric impulse.
But if some outside cause weakened a True Ancestor’s power, what do you think would happen to the impulse being restrained?”
…If some outside cause weakened her power…?
If she spent that power healing terrible wounds—or if she had once been killed as completely as anything could be killed and exhausted herself returning to life—

Such as, receiving a wound which requires power to heal, or using power to regenerate after being killed completely---

……アルクェイドには十の力があるとしよう。

　けどもし―――何かの要因で十の力のうち五の力を失ってしまったら、たとえ残った力全てを使っても、彼女は自分自身に対して五の力しか使えない。
　なら、足りない分の数は。
　そのまま、彼女自身から何を引いていくのだろうか―――

…Suppose Arcueid possessed ten measures of power.
Suppose she had always devoted seven of them to suppressing her desire for blood.
But if some event robbed her of five, then even by turning all her remaining strength inward, she could oppose that desire with only five.
Then what would that missing strength
strip away from Arcueid herself?

「……それで。
その衝動っていうのを抑えられなくなった真祖っていうのはどうなるんだよ、先輩」
「もちろん人の血を吸います。
そのあとには何もありません。
一度衝動に負けた真祖は、あとは堕ちていくだけです。
　一度血の味を知った真祖は、その衝動による痛みも倍化すると聞きます。
結果として、もう二度と吸血衝動を堪えることができなくなる。
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“…What happens to a True Ancestor who can no longer suppress the impulse?”
“Naturally, they drink human blood. Nothing remains after that. Once a True Ancestor yields to the impulse, the only direction left is downward.
I am told that once they learn the taste of blood, the pain of the impulse doubles. They can never resist it again.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… And?
What happens to those True Ancestors who couldn't resist, Senpai?"
"They drink human blood, of course.
After that, nothing.
Once they give in, they can only keep on falling.
Once a True Ancestor knows the taste of blood, I hear the urge becomes many times more painful than before.
As a result, they aren't able to resist the urge anymore.

「そうして、そうなってしまった真祖は魔王と呼ばれ恐れられるんです。
　真祖たちは確かに極めて優れた種ですが、自分の吸血衝動は自身の能力で抑えなくてはいけない、という枷があるために全力を出せません。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Those who fall that far are feared as demon lords.
True Ancestors are an exceptionally powerful species, but the need to restrain their own vampiric impulse prevents them from using their full strength.
A fallen True Ancestor has no need to bind itself. It becomes a monster that drinks human blood for nothing but its own pleasure.”

But once they fall, there's no longer the need to restrain themselves.
Then, they just become demons which suck human blood for their own pleasure."

Bloodshot eyes.

she said it herself. She was afraid to drink blood—

Because she knows that once she starts, she’ll never be able to stop.

lines.japanese:
「……ただ、かろうじて救いがあるとしたら、衝動は突発的なものだという事です。

それが死徒と呼ばれるモノたちの始まりですね。
　カレらはすでに死でいる使徒。
　真祖たちにおける、苦しい時の痛み止めとして生かされている吸血鬼。
それがこの街に巣くっているような吸血鬼の正体です。

lines.maoEnglish:
“……The one small mercy is that the impulse comes in sudden attacks.
Each True Ancestor kept a single servant in reserve for those moments when the craving became unbearable.
That was how the beings called Dead Apostles first came to be—apostles already dead.
Vampires kept alive as medicine for a True Ancestor’s pain. That is the true nature of the vampires infesting this city.”

lines.mirrorMoon:

They are something that is already dead.
A vampire kept alive for the sake of easing the pain of the True Ancestors.
That is the form of the vampire in this city."

「……いいえ。
それでも限界は来るんです、遠野くん。
　吸血衝動に果てはありませんし、消えることもないんです。
何度も何度も抑えてきた衝動という沈澱物は、そのうち器から溢れてしまう。
　彼らは長く生きれば生きるほど、自らに抱えた吸血衝動を肥大化させていってしまう。
　そうして自分の力で自身の衝動を抑えきれなくなった時―――自らの衝動が自らの能力を超えてしまった時、彼らは仲間の手によって命を絶たれます。
　それが寿命のない彼らにとっての寿命なんです」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“……No. The end will come even then, Tohno.
The vampiric impulse is endless. It never disappears. Every craving they suppress leaves sediment behind, until at last the vessel overflows.
The longer they live, the greater the impulse inside them grows.
And when their own power can no longer contain it—when the impulse becomes stronger than they are—their kin put them to death.
That is the only lifespan possessed by beings who do not age.”
lines.mao_english:
“……No. The end will come even then, Tohno.
The vampiric impulse is endless. It never disappears. Every craving they suppress leaves sediment behind, until at last the vessel overflows.
The longer they live, the greater the impulse inside them grows.
And when their own power can no longer contain it—when the impulse becomes stronger than they are—their kin put them to death.
That is the only lifespan possessed by beings who do not age.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Technically, but there is a limit, Tohno-kun.
The vampiric impulse has no end, and it will not go away.
The resisted urges which build again and again will eventually overflow their vessel.
The longer they live, the larger the vampiric impulse in them gets.
And when they can no longer restrain themselves with their own power--when the impulse overwhelms their power, their lives are ended by others.
That is the life span for those without life spans."

lines.japanese:
「――でも、アルクェイドは大丈夫なんだよ。
いまは俺のせいで力が弱ってるけど、何日かたてば、きっと―――」
「……そうかもしれません。
けれど、もともと彼女は限界なんです。
　いくら実際の活動時間が数年に満たないと言っても、彼女の存在時間そのものは変わらない。
　長く彼女の中にわだかまった衝動は、じき彼女自身を食い破ります。
その時がこの瞬間ではないと断言できるモノは何一つないんです。
　彼女は―――アルクェイドは、もう助からない命なんです」
lines.label: s189
lines.maoEnglish:
“But Arcueid will be all right. She’s weak now because of what I did, but give her a few days and she’ll—” “……Perhaps.
But she was already approaching her limit.
She may have spent less than a handful of years awake, but that does not change how long she has existed.
The hunger that has festered inside her for centuries will soon tear its way out. Nothing can guarantee that it has not chosen this very moment.
Arcueid’s life—cannot be saved.”
lines.mao_english:
“But Arcueid will be all right. She’s weak now because of what I did, but give her a few days and she’ll—” “……Perhaps.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"--But Arcueid is okay.
She's just weak because of me, so after a few days, she'll---"
"…… Perhaps.
But she's reached her limit already.
Even though she was only actually active for a few years, the amount of time of her existence does not change.
The urge which has grown inside her will soon consume her.
There's no denying that now is not the time.
She---Arcueid's life cannot be saved."

It was something another person had said. The dizziness swallowed everything before my eyes.

lines.maoEnglish:
“The other True Ancestors, I imagine.
Arcueid was born in the twelfth century, when Dead Apostles and fallen True Ancestors were more numerous than ever.
The True Ancestors could ignore neither their fallen kin nor the Dead Apostles those kin multiplied without restraint.
And so they created the purest of their kind, a creature who needed nothing beyond the act of killing, and made her their executioner.
That creature was Arcueid.
They say she was like a nuclear missile without a will of its own: once released from the castle, whatever vampire had been designated as her target was certain to be annihilated.”

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Shiki realizes that something has ended in a hopeless, final way after Arcueid leaves him. 'Desperately ends' misattaches the adverb, changes the completed event to present tense, and produces English that does not express the despair of the ending.

「―――――――」
　気が狂う前に、何も考えられなくなった。
　……みーん、と。
耳の奥で、蝉の声が聞こえる。
　蝉の、ぬけがら。
　自分の体が軽くて、中には何も入っていなくて、考えることさえ出来なくなった。
　魂が抜けるというのはこういうコトか。
lines.label: s193
lines.maoEnglish:
“—”
Before madness can take me, thought itself shuts down.
…A cicada drones somewhere deep inside my ears.
A cicada’s empty shell.
My body feels weightless and hollow, without even the power to think.
So this is what it means to lose your soul.

メルシー！
　クライマックスでデッドエンドを迎えてしまった残念な遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。

　この分だと三日目ぐらいまでいきそうで吐き気がしますね。
　それでは一時間目の授業を始めましょう。

lines.maoEnglish:

It’s time for Teach Me, Ciel!, the feature for poor unfortunate Tohno,
who managed to hit a dead end right at the climax.

At this rate we may make it to day three, and the thought turns my stomach.
Now, let’s begin our first lesson.

“Mreow!”

lines.label: s519
lines.maoEnglish:
――――Now, then.
So, Tohno, you’ve ended up here.
I’m afraid you’ll have to resubmit your work from quite a long way back.
Sadly, the feelings Arcueid had begun to develop for you weren’t strong enough to overcome her vampiric impulse.
Restart from a day or two earlier and try deepening your bond.
Oh, and one other thing.
Even if you’d been bewitched, Tohno, losing control that easily was rather ill-advised.
